title: Augustana Expands Government & International Affairs Department With Four Specialized Majors
summary_en: In Fall 2026, the Augustana UniversityGovernment & International Affairs Departmentexpanded its degree program offerings to include more specialized majors — giving students focused pathways aligned with their interests, workforce demands and graduate school preparation.
